cues.text: A deserted back street. Nozomi walks in with two men, and a bitter-looking middle-aged man stands waiting there.
Nozomi turns around to find the two men closing in on him. You come running up.
Nozomi is in tears. The two men turn and walk off, and Nozomi scurries over to your side.
The bitter-looking man walks away, leaving you with Nozomi, who is still crying.
